data.headline: Raise price 2% after one week; add one week of stock now
data.why: The staged plan lifts profit by the figures above and pays back in two weeks without breaching the 3,000 cash limit. Rivals stay at 1.50, so a small rise keeps the 45 percent who prefer you. Extra stock covers the one-week lead time if palm oil costs climb further.
data.watch_out: Indonesia's mandatory domestic palm oil sales could push input costs above the 35 percent exposed share, squeezing margin before the price rise takes full effect.
data.recheck_when: Recheck when Indonesia revises the DMO rule or palm oil futures jump again.

what_happened.text: Indonesia, the biggest producer, banned palm oil exports to bring down its own cooking oil prices.
Indonesia lifted the ban after less than four weeks, saying its supply had more than tripled.
Malaysian palm oil futures fell to a near 13-month low, about 40% below the April peak.
The World Bank's monthly palm oil price was $889 a tonne, down from $1,683 in April.

caveats: Frying oil is set at 35% of a pack's cost. This is our estimate for a small fried-snack maker; we found no published share.
The series is the world palm oil export price (Pink Sheet, monthly, $/mt). Malaysian retail cooking oil in small packs is subsidised; a bulk buyer pays closer to the market price, with a lag.
Each monthly value is treated as the month's mid-point, with straight lines between them.

The model has seen this period. Nemotron Ultra's model card gives a pre-training cutoff of September 2025 and a post-training cutoff of May 2026, so a date in the prompt cannot make it forget. The run only gives it news from before the date, and the leak check looks for hindsight in what it wrote.

“Best plan in hindsight” is the best of about 230 plans on a fixed grid (price, start, end, extra stock), run on the real path. Shoppers react to a sweep plan like they did to the nearest price plan the analysis tested; with none tested, they are neutral.
News pages are read as they are today. Any article that names a date after the as-of date is dropped, but a page edited later could still carry hindsight.
